title: Index Pairs of a String
description:
Given a string `text` and an array of strings `words`, return *an array of all index pairs *`[i, j]`* so that the substring *`text[i...j]`* is in `words`*.

Return the pairs `[i, j]` in sorted order (i.e., sort them by their first coordinate, and in case of ties sort them by their second coordinate).

examples.explanation: Notice that matches can overlap, see "aba" is found in [0,2] and [2,4].

constraints: text and words[i] consist of lowercase English letters.
All the strings of words are unique.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Index Pairs of a String.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
